__doc__.purpose: A ready-to-run example for the API testing feature. It talks to jsonplaceholder.typicode.com — a free public fake REST API — so it works with no setup (needs internet).
__doc__.run_in_ui: Topbar → API & Perf → API tests → pick 'JSONPlaceholder demo' → Run API suite.
__doc__.run_in_cli: npm run qa:api -- example-jsonplaceholder.json   (exit code 1 if any assertion fails).
what_it_shows: maxLatencyMs — request must return within N ms
bodyContains — raw substring must appear in the response
headers — case-insensitive substring match on a response header
json — dot-path checks: literal value ($.id: 1), type ('number'/'string'/'array'), existence ('exists'), nesting ($.address.city), array index ($[0].userId)
capture — pull a value from one response ($.userId) into a variable (AUTHOR_ID) reused by later requests via {{AUTHOR_ID}}
{{VAR}} — resolves from variables, captured values, then process.env (so secrets can come from the environment, e.g. {{PASSWORD}})
__doc__.note: Files starting with _ (like _TEMPLATE.json) are treated as templates and are NOT listed as runnable suites.
